answer: Every identity must register a unique harbor station sampling local zephyr wind vectors across a ridge of timestamps. Each epoch it signs a commitment to the exact sequence; weather oracles and neighboring stations cross-check spatial consistency. A farm of one thousand fakes must either deploy one thousand real dispersed harbors—hardware, power and site costs rising linearly—or forge sequences that fail the ridge tests and lose locked collateral. Honest agents instrument one sensor; attackers cannot parallelize the physical measurement.
